description: U8_Ash character creation. These are this game's rules, not part of the vendored Ash V1 package: ability bonuses, ancestries, and the two ways to roll a character. Changing a value here changes the game without touching engine code.

ability_bonuses.description: floor((score - 10) / 2), written out so the curve is tunable. Generation never exceeds 18; talents carry a score to 20.

ancestries.name: Human
ancestries.description: Humans take two rolls on their class talent table where another ancestry takes one.

ironman.description: 3d6 in order. A set is kept only if it is playable; otherwise the whole set is rolled again.

unearthed_arcana.description: Choose the class first; its priority order takes the pools in turn, each keeping its three highest dice.
